title: HinMil project configuration
description: Project-level configuration for the HinMil language server. Loaded from 'hinmil.config.json', 'hinmil.config.js' or the "hinmil" key of package.json.

enable.markdownDescription: Run the HinMil language server for this project. Set to `false` to disable HinMil from within the repository itself (no editor settings needed).

globals.markdownDescription: Paths to globals file(s), relative to the project root. Each entry's contents are concatenated (in order) to form the project-wide globals. Defaults to `globals.hm` when present.

overrides.markdownDescription: Per-package `.hm` override sidecars keyed by bare package name (e.g. `"sqlkit": "./hm-types/sqlkit.hm"`). The override is merged on top of the package's own sidecar.

typesDir.markdownDescription: Directory (relative to the project root) for conventional `<typesDir>/<pkg>.hm` package type stubs. Default: `hm-types`.

fileSelection.markdownDescription: Standalone diagnostic file selection. Excluded files remain available for dependency inference.

settings.markdownDescription: Editor-settings overrides shared through the repo. Same shape as the VS Code `hinmil.*` settings; merged ON TOP of the editor settings (project file wins where it specifies a value).

enabled.description: Master switch: enable or disable all HinMil diagnostics.

debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before publishing diagnostics after a document change. Only affects diagnostics — hover, completion and signature help respond immediately regardless of this value.

enumDescriptions: Trust user-written signatures: suppress annotation-vs-inferred mismatch diagnostics.
Also suppress diagnostics inside the body of any binding that carries a '::' annotation.
Also suppress diagnostics inside the body of every binding (annotated or not). 'missingSignatures' still nudges unsigned bindings.
trustAnnotations.markdownDescription: How aggressively to trust user-written `::` annotations. Each level is a superset of the previous.

typeErrors.description: Type mismatch and unification errors: annotation-vs-implementation mismatches, non-callable calls, infinite types.

unknownPropertyAccess.description: Accessing a property that does not exist on a known type.

missingRecordFields.description: Returning a record that is missing fields required by the annotated return type.

excessRecordFields.description: An object literal passed where a named record type (an alias such as `RangeParams`) is expected has a field that type does not declare (a typo such as `form` for an optional `from`).

annotationNarrowing.description: Reserved: code 2009, not emitted at the moment.

missingSignatures.description: Functions and methods that have no HM type annotation.

missingVariableSignatures.description: Non-function variable declarations that have no HM type annotation.

enabled.description: Enable auto-completions for methods and record fields.

autoImports.description: Suggest not-yet-imported workspace exports (with an auto-added import statement) in identifier completions. Disabling this also stops the background workspace-export scan.

enabled.description: Show parameter type information when calling functions.

enumDescriptions: hinmil answers go to definition for imports and local names when VS Code's built-in TypeScript/JavaScript extension is not active.
definitions.description: Go to definition for code: module paths, imported names (ESM, CommonJS, dynamic import), re-exports up to the real declaration, and local names.

enumDescriptions: Use readable names (a, b, c) for type variables.
Use internal type variable names (t0, t1, ...).
typeVariables.description: Style for displaying type variables in hover tooltips, completions and code actions.

globalTypes.description: Give browser globals (document, window, navigator, localStorage, sessionStorage) real nominal types with IntelliSense on a compact DOM catalogue, and make Document/Element/Window/Storage/Event/Navigator usable in '::' annotations. Members outside the catalogue silently resolve to Any. Disable if your project defines its own types with these names.

strictNulls.description: DOM lookups that can miss (getElementById, querySelector, getAttribute, Storage getItem, ...) return 'T | Null' instead of plain 'T'.
